name: fmwax-house
description: fmwax: a house of radio DJs on the presets of a WiiM. This file is for the Deploy to Cloudflare button; the house itself is in mcp/.

SETUP_KEY.description: **Paste your setup key here: the start page (https://renedebos.github.io/fmwax) makes one and keeps it for you.** Or a password of your own, 24 characters or more, written in a note first: this box hides what you type, and the key claims your house on its setup page.
